notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the language manager and loading save files
[*] Added steam achievements framework
[*] Added 3 steam achievements (more to come)
[/list]

Stay tuned! 📻

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[h1]Changes:[/h1][list]
    [*] Minor bug fixes for assigning roles after attempting to summon magic
    [*] Fixed issue where wolves would go to the tavern occasionally for a drink
    [*] Guards will no longer lay on the ground after being thrown at a fence
    [*] Added backwards compatibility for daemons saved before enum updates (new daemons added)
    [*] Unit sources are now destroyed on load to prevent phantom tree harvesting
    [*] Cleaned up graveyard blueprint placement settings
    [*] Cleaned up house 2 blueprint placement settings
    [*] Cleaned up school blueprint placement settings
    [*] Adjusted tree grab offsets for certain trees
    [*] Added Easter Egg
[/list]

[b]Notes:[/b] 
This update is primarily bug fixes. The next update will contain new content.

There are some major changes to the positioning of some of the buildings and save files will reflect that. Old buildings that may now appear to be underground or floating should be burned and rebuilt to correct the issue. This change make it easier to place certain building properly.

Looking into a better way to address language translation issues.

Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]

    [*] Updated launcher image to be company logo

Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]

More patches in the works. Very busy, please be patient.

notes.title: Version 0.07.013 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Added progressive build shader for blueprints (experimental)
    [*] Added blood to daemon death
    [*] Added blood to daemon injure
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
      [*] When a mission is completed it is disabled instead of destroyed to prevent issues loading between saves
      [*] Mission are now disabled instead of destroyed when loading between saves 
      [*] Fixed issue where some boundary circles do not generate on load in certain cases
      [*] Fixed issue where old boundary circles persist when loading a regressive save 
      [*] Fixed issue where disabled boundaries where generated on load
      [*] Minor changes to tree shaders
[/list]

Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]

notes.title: Version 0.07.002 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Animals can now be converted to food based on size
    [*] Added quick villager summary that can be toggled with "Tab"
    [*] Added keybinding for quick villager summary
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
      [*] When villagers are sleeping in beds thier hair color will now match thier age.
      [*] Blueprint percentage will now update on load
      [*] 3D text will now update immediatly when the language is changed
      [*] Moved QuickMagic keybinding up the list with other "Quick" bindings
      [*] Clothing on unassigned female will no longer disappear when close up in presence mode 
      [*] Villager Summary now supports different languages
      [*] Children who are on fire no longer scream like adults
      [*] Female villagers will now scream at a higher pitch when on fire
      [*] Water magic can now properly extinguish villagers who are on fire
      [*] Updated influence behavior for Dock Town quest
      [*] Fixed issue where time is frozen in main menu
[/list]

Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]

notes.title: Version 0.07.001 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Language Support for 15 languages
    [*] Added language support for French
    [*] Added language support for Italian
    [*] Added language support for German
    [*] Added language support for Spanish
    [*] Added language support for Czech
    [*] Added language support for Dutch
    [*] Added language support for Japanese
    [*] Added language support for Korean
    [*] Added language support for Polish
    [*] Added language support for Portuguese
    [*] Added language support for Russian
    [*] Added language support for Traditional Chinese
    [*] Added language support for Simplified Chinese
    [*] Added language support for Turkish
    [*] Added limited key binding support to launcher (more later).
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
      [*] Updated Villager Summary
      [*] Simplified magic spell names for translation reasons
      [*] Moved some trees on the far side of the island that were underwater. This change requires a[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/0/1640915206455815518/] terrain bypass[/url] for existing saves.
      [*] Fixed issue where 2 initial farmers would sometimes snap to grid and remain idle
      [*] Daemons will no longer "think" when the game is paused
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]
[list]
      [*] CJK languages do not update for 3D text immdiately (they will update on the next interaction).
[/list]


Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]

notes.title: Version 0.06.036 Update
notes.content:
[h1]New:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Added sandbox mode
    [*] Added return to menu button
    [*] Added new Daemon "Forester" (plants trees)
    [*] Added new building "Forester Shack"
    [*] Updated Guide
    [*] Daemon for "Supplies" now called "Lumberjack"
    [*] Daemon for "Food" now called "Farmer"
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Children can now be drowned and will no longer walk on the ocean floor
    [*] Child carry offset increased
    [*] Children will no longer talk like an adult when drowning
    [*] Animals can no longer walk underwater
    [*] Assign types now in alphabetical order
    [*] Fixed chest renderer in House01 and House02
    [*] Reduced delay when planting trees
    [*] Main Menu cursor now matches in game cursor
[/list]

Questions or feedback? [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1023390/discussions/]Start a discussion![/url]
